pages.text: A $(l)Quiver$() carries several arrow types at once and lets you swap between them on the fly: hold the quiver modifier key and scroll to cycle the selected slot.

pages.title: Running Dry
pages.text: When the selected slot runs out, the quiver moves on to the next slot that still has arrows, so it keeps feeding your bow until it is properly empty.$(br2)The $(l)Quick Nock$() enchantment goes further and advances after $(o)every$() shot, cycling through your arrow types as you fire.
